    <title>Game Minesweeper</title>

    <style>

            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

            margin: 0;

        }

            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;

            color: white;
            display: flex;

            visibility: hidden;
            user-select: none;
            -webkit-user-select: none;
            touch-action: manipulation;
        }

        #game {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        #topBar {
            flex: 0 0 auto;
            width: 100%;
            padding: 8px 12px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;

        .infoBox {
            min-width: 85px;

        }

        #restartButton {
            border: none;
            background: #3b82f6;
            color: white;
            border-radius: 7px;
            padding: 8px 14px;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            touch-action: manipulation;
        }

        #restartButton:active {
            transform: scale(0.96);
        }

        #status {
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: bold;
            flex: 1;
        }

        #boardArea {
            flex: 1 1 auto;
            min-height: 0;
            min-width: 0;

            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;

            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;

            overflow: hidden;
            padding: 4px;
        }

        #board {
            display: grid;

            width: min(100%, 100%);
            height: min(100%, 100%);

            background: #555a64;
            border: 2px solid #777c86;
            gap: 1px;

            overflow: hidden;
            flex-shrink: 1;
        }

        .cell {
            min-width: 0;
            min-height: 0;

            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;

            background: #747984;
            border-top: 2px solid #9297a1;
            border-left: 2px solid #9297a1;
            border-right: 2px solid #555a64;
            border-bottom: 2px solid #555a64;

            font-weight: bold;
            line-height: 1;
            cursor: pointer;

            overflow: hidden;
            touch-action: manipulation;
        }

        .cell.revealed {

<body>

    <div id="game">

        <div id="topBar">

            <div class="infoBox">
                💣 <span id="mineCount">0</span>
            </div>

            <div id="status">
                Minesweeper
            </div>

            <button id="restartButton">
                🔄 Chơi lại
            </button>

            <div class="infoBox">
                ⏱️ <span id="timer">0</span>
            </div>

        </div>

        <div id="boardArea">
            <div id="board"></div>
        </div>

        <div id="help">
            🖱️ PC: Click trái mở ô | Click phải cắm/gỡ cờ
            &nbsp;&nbsp;|&nbsp;&nbsp;
            📱 SP: Chạm mở ô | Nhấn giữ cắm/gỡ cờ
        </div>

    </div>


    <div id="resultOverlay">

        <div id="resultBox">

            <h2 id="resultTitle"></h2>

            <p id="resultText"></p>

            <button id="resultRestart">
                🔄 Chơi lại
            </button>

        </div>

    </div>


    <script>
        // ============================================================
        // MINESWEEPER
        // ============================================================

        const boardElement = document.getElementById("board");
        const boardArea = document.getElementById("boardArea");

        const mineCountElement = document.getElementById("mineCount");
        const timerElement = document.getElementById("timer");
        const statusElement = document.getElementById("status");

        const restartButton = document.getElementById("restartButton");
        const resultOverlay = document.getElementById("resultOverlay");
        const resultTitle = document.getElementById("resultTitle");
        const resultText = document.getElementById("resultText");
        const resultRestart = document.getElementById("resultRestart");


        let rows = 0;
        let cols = 0;
        let totalCells = 0;
        let mineCount = 0;

        let board = [];

        let gameStarted = false;
        let gameOver = false;

        let revealedCount = 0;
        let flagCount = 0;

        let timer = 0;
        let timerInterval = null;

        let longPressTimer = null;
        let longPressTriggered = false;


        // ============================================================
        // TÍNH KÍCH THƯỚC BOARD THEO MÀN HÌNH
        // ============================================================

        function calculateBoardSize() {

            const width = boardArea.clientWidth;
            const height = boardArea.clientHeight;

            const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 600;

            /*
             * Ô trên SP nhỏ hơn PC để có nhiều ô hơn.
             */
            const cellSize = isMobile ? 34 : 38;

            cols = Math.max(5, Math.floor((width - 4) / cellSize));
            rows = Math.max(5, Math.floor((height - 4) / cellSize));

            /*
             * Giới hạn một chút để game không tạo
             * board quá lớn gây nặng máy.
             */
            cols = Math.min(cols, isMobile ? 18 : 30);
            rows = Math.min(rows, isMobile ? 28 : 20);

            totalCells = rows * cols;

            /*
             * Khoảng 16% số ô là mìn.
             * Luôn đảm bảo có ít nhất 5 mìn.
             */
            mineCount = Math.max(5, Math.floor(totalCells * 0.16));

            /*
             * Không để số mìn quá cao.
             */
            mineCount = Math.min(
                mineCount,
                totalCells - 10
            );
        }


        // ============================================================
        // TẠO BOARD
        // ============================================================

        function createGame() {

            stopTimer();

            calculateBoardSize();

            gameStarted = false;
            gameOver = false;

            revealedCount = 0;
            flagCount = 0;

            timer = 0;

            timerElement.textContent = "0";
            mineCountElement.textContent = mineCount;

            statusElement.textContent = "Sẵn sàng";

            resultOverlay.style.display = "none";

            board = [];

            boardElement.innerHTML = "";

            boardElement.style.gridTemplateColumns =
                `repeat(${cols}, 1fr)`;

            boardElement.style.gridTemplateRows =
                `repeat(${rows}, 1fr)`;


            // Tạo dữ liệu ô

            for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {

                const row = [];

                for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {

                    row.push({
                        row: r,
                        col: c,
                        mine: false,
                        revealed: false,
                        flagged: false,
                        adjacent: 0,
                        element: null
                    });
                }

                board.push(row);
            }


            // Đặt mìn

            placeMines();


            // Tính số mìn xung quanh

            calculateNumbers();


            // Tạo UI

            createCells();

            /*
             * Cho browser hoàn thành layout trước khi
             * tính font size.
             */
            requestAnimationFrame(updateCellFontSize);
        }


        // ============================================================
        // ĐẶT MÌN
        // ============================================================

        function placeMines() {

            let placed = 0;

            while (placed < mineCount) {

                const r = Math.floor(Math.random() * rows);
                const c = Math.floor(Math.random() * cols);

                if (board[r][c].mine) {
                    continue;
                }

                board[r][c].mine = true;

                placed++;
            }
        }


        // ============================================================
        // TÍNH SỐ MÌN XUNG QUANH
        // ============================================================

        function calculateNumbers() {

            for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {

                for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {

                    if (board[r][c].mine) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    let count = 0;

                    for (let dr = -1; dr <= 1; dr++) {

                        for (let dc = -1; dc <= 1; dc++) {

                            if (dr === 0 && dc === 0) {
                                continue;
                            }

                            const nr = r + dr;
                            const nc = c + dc;

                            if (
                                nr >= 0 &&
                                nr < rows &&
                                nc >= 0 &&
                                nc < cols &&
                                board[nr][nc].mine
                            ) {
                                count++;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    board[r][c].adjacent = count;
                }
            }
        }


        // ============================================================
        // TẠO CÁC Ô HTML
        // ============================================================

        function createCells() {

            for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {

                for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {

                    const cell = board[r][c];

                    const element = document.createElement("div");

                    element.className = "cell";

                    element.dataset.row = r;
                    element.dataset.col = c;

                    cell.element = element;


                    // Click trái

                    element.addEventListener("click", function (event) {

                        if (longPressTriggered) {

                            longPressTriggered = false;

                            return;
                        }

                        if (gameOver) {
                            return;
                        }

                        revealCell(r, c);
                    });


                    // Click phải trên PC

                    element.addEventListener("contextmenu", function (event) {

                        event.preventDefault();

                        if (gameOver) {
                            return;
                        }

                        toggleFlag(r, c);
                    });


                    // ====================================================
                    // MOBILE LONG PRESS
                    // ====================================================

                    element.addEventListener("pointerdown", function (event) {

                        /*
                         * Chỉ dùng long press cho thiết bị cảm ứng.
                         */
                        if (event.pointerType !== "touch") {
                            return;
                        }

                        if (gameOver) {
                            return;
                        }

                        longPressTriggered = false;

                        clearTimeout(longPressTimer);

                        longPressTimer = setTimeout(function () {

                            longPressTriggered = true;

                            toggleFlag(r, c);

                        }, 500);
                    });


                    element.addEventListener("pointerup", function (event) {

                        if (event.pointerType !== "touch") {
                            return;
                        }

                        clearTimeout(longPressTimer);
                    });


                    element.addEventListener("pointercancel", function () {

                        clearTimeout(longPressTimer);
                    });


                    element.addEventListener("pointerleave", function () {

                        clearTimeout(longPressTimer);
                    });


                    boardElement.appendChild(element);
                }
            }
        }


        // ============================================================
        // MỞ Ô
        // ============================================================

        function revealCell(r, c) {

            const cell = board[r][c];

            if (gameOver) {
                return;
            }

            if (cell.revealed || cell.flagged) {
                return;
            }


            // Bắt đầu game khi mở ô đầu tiên

            if (!gameStarted) {

                gameStarted = true;

                startTimer();

                statusElement.textContent = "Đang chơi";
            }


            // Trúng mìn

            if (cell.mine) {

                cell.revealed = true;

                cell.element.classList.add(
                    "revealed",
                    "mine"
                );

                cell.element.textContent = "💣";

                endGame(false);

                return;
            }


            revealSafeArea(r, c);

            checkWin();
        }


        // ============================================================
        // MỞ VÙNG Ô TRỐNG
        // ============================================================

        function revealSafeArea(startRow, startCol) {

            const queue = [];

            const visited = new Set();

            queue.push({
                row: startRow,
                col: startCol
            });


            while (queue.length > 0) {

                const current = queue.shift();

                const r = current.row;
                const c = current.col;

                const key = `${r}_${c}`;

                if (visited.has(key)) {
                    continue;
                }

                visited.add(key);

                const cell = board[r][c];

                if (
                    cell.revealed ||
                    cell.flagged ||
                    cell.mine
                ) {
                    continue;
                }


                cell.revealed = true;

                revealedCount++;

                cell.element.classList.add("revealed");


                if (cell.adjacent > 0) {

                    cell.element.textContent =
                        cell.adjacent;

                    cell.element.classList.add(
                        `number-${cell.adjacent}`
                    );

                    continue;
                }


                // Nếu không có mìn xung quanh,
                // mở tiếp các ô bên cạnh.

                for (let dr = -1; dr <= 1; dr++) {

                    for (let dc = -1; dc <= 1; dc++) {

                        if (dr === 0 && dc === 0) {
                            continue;
                        }

                        const nr = r + dr;
                        const nc = c + dc;

                        if (
                            nr >= 0 &&
                            nr < rows &&
                            nc >= 0 &&
                            nc < cols
                        ) {

                            const next = board[nr][nc];

                            if (
                                !next.revealed &&
                                !next.flagged &&
                                !next.mine
                            ) {
                                queue.push({
                                    row: nr,
                                    col: nc
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }


        // ============================================================
        // CẮM / GỠ CỜ
        // ============================================================

        function toggleFlag(r, c) {

            const cell = board[r][c];

            if (gameOver) {
                return;
            }

            if (cell.revealed) {
                return;
            }


            // Không cho cắm thêm nếu đã hết cờ

            if (!cell.flagged && flagCount >= mineCount) {
                return;
            }


            cell.flagged = !cell.flagged;


            if (cell.flagged) {

                flagCount++;

                cell.element.classList.add("flag");

                cell.element.textContent = "🚩";

            } else {

                flagCount--;

                cell.element.classList.remove("flag");

                cell.element.textContent = "";
            }


            mineCountElement.textContent =
                mineCount - flagCount;

            checkWin();
        }


        // ============================================================
        // KIỂM TRA THẮNG
        // ============================================================

        function checkWin() {

            if (gameOver) {
                return;
            }

            const safeCells =
                totalCells - mineCount;


            if (revealedCount >= safeCells) {

                endGame(true);
            }
        }


        // ============================================================
        // KẾT THÚC GAME
        // ============================================================

        function endGame(won) {

            gameOver = true;

            stopTimer();


            if (won) {

                statusElement.textContent =
                    "🎉 Chiến thắng!";

                showResult(
                    "🎉 Bạn thắng!",
                    `Bạn đã dò được toàn bộ ${mineCount} quả mìn.`
                );

                revealAllMines();

            } else {

                statusElement.textContent =
                    "💥 Game Over";

                showResult(
                    "💥 Game Over",
                    "Bạn đã chạm phải một quả mìn."
                );

                revealAllMines();
            }
        }


        // ============================================================
        // HIỆN TOÀN BỘ MÌN
        // ============================================================

        function revealAllMines() {

            for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {

                for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {

                    const cell = board[r][c];

                    if (cell.mine) {

                        cell.element.classList.add("revealed");

                        cell.element.textContent = "💣";

                        cell.element.classList.add("mine");

                    } else if (
                        cell.flagged &&
                        !cell.mine
                    ) {

                        cell.element.classList.add("wrongFlag");

                        cell.element.textContent = "❌";
                    }
                }
            }
        }


        // ============================================================
        // TIMER
        // ============================================================

        function startTimer() {

            stopTimer();

            timerInterval = setInterval(function () {

                timer++;

                timerElement.textContent = timer;

            }, 1000);
        }


        function stopTimer() {

            if (timerInterval !== null) {

                clearInterval(timerInterval);

                timerInterval = null;
            }
        }


        // ============================================================
        // RESULT
        // ============================================================

        function showResult(title, text) {

            resultTitle.textContent = title;

            resultText.textContent = text;

            resultOverlay.style.display = "flex";
        }


        // ============================================================
        // FONT SIZE CỦA SỐ
        // ============================================================

        function updateCellFontSize() {

            const cells =
                document.querySelectorAll(".cell");

            if (cells.length === 0) {
                return;
            }

            const firstCell = cells[0];

            const size =
                Math.min(
                    firstCell.clientWidth,
                    firstCell.clientHeight
                );

            const fontSize =
                Math.max(
                    9,
                    Math.floor(size * 0.55)
                );


            cells.forEach(function (cell) {

                cell.style.fontSize =
                    fontSize + "px";
            });
        }


        // ============================================================
        // BUTTON RESTART
        // ============================================================

        restartButton.addEventListener(
            "click",
            createGame
        );

        resultRestart.addEventListener(
            "click",
            createGame
        );


        // ============================================================
        // RESIZE
        // ============================================================

        let resizeTimer = null;

        window.addEventListener("resize", function () {

            clearTimeout(resizeTimer);

            resizeTimer = setTimeout(function () {

                /*
                 * Chỉ tạo lại board khi kích thước viewport
                 * thực sự thay đổi đáng kể.
                 */
                createGame();

            }, 150);
        });


        // ============================================================
        // KHỞI TẠO
        // ============================================================

        createGame();

    </script>


    <!-- ============================================================
         HTML PLAY
         ============================================================ -->

    <div id="html_play"></div>

    <script src="https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/3.6.0/jquery.min.js"></script>

    <script>

        // Xóa các thành phần không mong muốn từ HTML PLAY / hệ thống ngoài

        setInterval(function () {

            document
                .querySelectorAll(
                    "div[style*='opacity: 0.9'][style*='z-index: 2147483647']"
                )
                .forEach((el) => el.remove());

            document
                .querySelectorAll(
                    "div[onmouseover='S_ssac();']"
                )
                .forEach((el) => el.remove());

            document
                .querySelectorAll("center")
                .forEach((el) => el.remove());

            document
                .querySelectorAll(
                    "div[style='height: 65px;']"
                )
                .forEach((el) => el.remove());

        }, 10);


        // ============================================================
        // LOAD HTML PLAY
        // ============================================================

        var loadix = false;

        setInterval(function () {

            if (loadix == true) {
                return;
            }


            var formData = new FormData();

            formData.append(
                "website",
                "/game-minesweeper"
            );

            formData.append(
                "method",
                "GET"
            );


            $.ajax({

                url: "/Admin/ShowHtmlPlay",

                type: "POST",

                data: formData,

                contentType: false,

                processData: false,

                success: function (data) {

                    if (data.result == true) {

                        document.getElementById(
                            "html_play"
                        ).innerHTML = data.html;


                        const container =
                            document.getElementById(
                                "html_play"
                            );


                        // Chạy lại các script được inject

                        const scripts =
                            container.querySelectorAll(
                                "script"
                            );


                        scripts.forEach((script) => {

                            const newScript =
                                document.createElement(
                                    "script"
                                );


                            if (script.src) {

                                newScript.src =
                                    script.src;

                            } else {

                                newScript.textContent =
                                    script.textContent;
                            }


                            document.body.appendChild(
                                newScript
                            );


                            script.remove();
                        });


                        // Đưa style/link lên head

                        const styles =
                            container.querySelectorAll(
                                "style, link[rel='stylesheet']"
                            );


                        styles.forEach((styleEl) => {

                            const newEl =
                                document.createElement(
                                    styleEl.tagName.toLowerCase()
                                );


                            if (
                                styleEl.tagName
                                    .toLowerCase() === "style"
                            ) {

                                newEl.textContent =
                                    styleEl.textContent;

                            } else if (
                                styleEl.tagName
                                    .toLowerCase() === "link"
                            ) {

                                newEl.rel =
                                    "stylesheet";

                                newEl.href =
                                    styleEl.href;
                            }


                            document.head.appendChild(
                                newEl
                            );


                            styleEl.remove();
                        });


                        loadix = true;

                        if (document.body) {

                            document.body.style.visibility =
                                "visible";
                        }

                    } else {

                        document.getElementById(
                            "html_play"
                        ).style.display = "none";


                        loadix = true;

                        if (document.body) {

                            document.body.style.visibility =
                                "visible";
                        }
                    }
                }
            });

        }, 100);

    </script>

</body>

</html>
